name: todo
description: A TODO.md task board (Todo / Doing / Done) with a side panel: quick capture, Claude enrichment with IDs, and done logs

autoOpen.title: Open the panel on start
autoOpen.description: Open the task panel when a session starts in a project that has a TODO.md (it docks beside the transcript on wide terminals).

autoArchive.title: Auto-archive Done after
autoArchive.description: When a task starts and Done holds more than this many tasks, the oldest move to TODO-archive.md and the newest 10 stay. 0 turns it off.
